params.body:
`share.mjs`: a document behind a link and a passphrase, from the workbench (portal#399).

```bash
node ~/Projects/portal-cli/share.mjs drafts/brief.md --slug bextrust [--title "…"] [--days 30]
```

The passphrase is made here (three groups of four letters, without the letters that read as digits) and printed once. Its PBKDF2-SHA256 hash and the document go through the gateway as one judged action, `portal.share`, the document attached and digest bound like an invoice on an expense. The link is read back with the hand's own signature and printed beside the passphrase, to send on different channels. Nothing of the word or the text is in the evidence record.

`lib/share.mjs` holds the passphrase, the hash and the title; `test/share.test.mjs` pins a PBKDF2 vector that Portal's `IngestShareTest` pins too, so the two sides cannot drift.

Companions: abovebeyond-ai/control (the kind), abovebeyond-ai/portal (the door), abovebeyond-ai/elixir (the workbench's kinds).
